purpose: Additive AMBIENT-001 candidate retrieval checks; frozen original questions remain unchanged.

questions.query: How do I create a Procedural NPC Ambient behaviour profile, assign Oil Moth and save it in ordinary Workbench?
facts: Configuration → Controllers opens the staged Behaviour profile editor with Apply acknowledgement and Revert.
Profiles and assignments save through ordinary Setup-v2; ephemeral timers, RNG and command leases restart.
Ambient is opt-in; accepted population is eight actors.

questions.query: Does a radius50 ambient Oil material sensor find the true nearest native cell or classify framebuffer colours?
facts: Copied native material-ID publication includes stored cells plus native ballistic projection; framebuffer colours are not material identity.
Inclusive circular Euclidean radius measures actor centre to cell centres on a four-cell sampled grid clipped to canvas.
Nearest observed sample is approximate; unavailable or stale coverage is not absence.

questions.query: How does an ambient ledge retreat persist for ten simulated seconds, pause, rearm and survive human handoff?
facts: Ledge and canvas boundary are separate observations.
Retreat latches original direction once; completed fixed Rapier steps advance time and pause preserves timers.
Human handoff retires pending authority; handback resets ephemeral intentions.

questions.query: How can I add a reusable deterministic ambient behaviour module without editing the native owner or movement motors?
facts: Register typed metadata and one pure-data evaluator; profile schema and editor consume common specs.
Keep private per-instance state and seeded randomness independent of inspection order.
Require actual observations and capabilities, produce bounded intent, and qualify through independent module and physical adapter tests.
